resources.title: Establishing Your Professional Baseline
resources.description: A short guide to help an experienced Change Management practitioner reflect on their current role, strengths, and development objectives before coaching begins.
resources.learning_objective: Help the practitioner articulate their current professional baseline across the six development dimensions.
when_to_recommend: Practitioner asks how to prepare for coaching
follow_up_questions: Which development dimension feels most relevant to your current work?
What would meaningful growth look like in that area?

resources.title: Observing Your Practice in Real Time
resources.description: A guide to help the practitioner bring real workplace situations into coaching and reflect on situation, interpretation, approach, behavior, and outcome.
resources.learning_objective: Help the practitioner structure a real workplace observation for coaching reflection.
when_to_recommend: Practitioner asks how to describe a situation for coaching
A significant workplace situation has occurred
follow_up_questions: What did you notice about your own approach in that situation?
How did you interpret what was happening before you acted?
